_comment: Public-figure discovery queries per research universe. Editable. 'fulltext' uses Wikidata CirrusSearch; 'sparql' uses query.wikidata.org and must bind ?item. Adults only: privacy rules additionally drop anyone under 18.

young_hollywood.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { VALUES ?occ { wd:Q33999 wd:Q10800557 wd:Q10798782 } ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wdt:P106 ?occ; wdt:P27 wd:Q30; wdt:P569 ?b; wikibase:sitelinks ?links . FILTER(YEAR(?b) >= 1995 && YEAR(?b) <= YEAR(NOW()) - 19) } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT {LIMIT}

marvel.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?work wdt:P179|wdt:P361|wdt:P1434 wd:Q642878 . ?work wdt:P161 ?item . ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wikibase:sitelinks ?links . } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT {LIMIT}

pop_music.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wdt:P106 wd:Q177220; wdt:P136 wd:Q37073; wikibase:sitelinks ?links . } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT {LIMIT}

ancient.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wdt:P569 ?b; wdt:P22 ?f; wikibase:sitelinks ?links . FILTER(YEAR(?b) < 0) } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT {LIMIT}
